title: Telemetry-driven fanout region selector with variant graceful-degradation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a region selection mechanism that uses live latency percentiles (p50/p95) plus an aggregated network health signal to pick candidate regions and decide on graceful fallback to cheaper/compatible model variants. Goal: reduce cross-region tail latency exposure while preserving throughput and cost targets for hosted API and Dedicated customers.
acceptance_criteria: Controller uses streaming telemetry (1s windows) to compute p50 and p95 per region per model and stores moving-window summaries
Routing decision outputs a ranked list of up to 3 regions with a reason vector (latency_score, network_health_score, capacity_score)
When top region p95 crosses configured threshold, controller triggers variant fallback (model-compat downgrade or quantized variant) and emits an event to observability
End-to-end e2e test that simulates region degradation and verifies that fallbacks preserve <2x cost increase and p95 improves or request rerouted within 250ms of detection
Config knobs available in Console: p50/p95 thresholds, health decay window, max fanout, variant fallback map
implementation_notes: Telemetry ingest: extend existing metrics stream with per-region per-model p50/p95 computed via t-digest on 1s micro-buckets
Network health composite: combine TCP connect failure rate, packet loss (from edge probes), and average SYN-ACK latency into a 0..1 health score with exponential decay (alpha=0.2) over 30s
Score aggregation: normalized latency_score = min(1, p95 / model_tolerance_ms). Final region_score = w1*(1 - latency_score) + w2*network_health + w3*capacity_util where weights are dynamic by tier
Decision engine: deterministic ranking with hysteresis (lockout 10s) to prevent flapping; fallbacks have rate limits and cooldowns

Variant mapping: maintain a compatibility matrix for each model family -> [full_float, int8_quant, distill_small]. Fallback prefers model variants with verified output-drift < 2% for the model's baseline eval set
APIs: add /routing/decision endpoint for other services to request pre-computed ranked regions for (customer_id, model_id, request_size)
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): enable for 5% of traffic on non-critical models in us-west and eu-west, observe false positives and flaps
Phase 2 (scale): expand to 30% with stricter hysteresis and tuned weights, add operator alerts for cross-region spill events
Phase 3 (GA): default on for Tiered customers with UI knobs in Console and automated regression checks
Rollback: feature flag off globally and immediate revert to current region-priority list if abnormal increase in 5xx or cost > 2x
tests: Unit: t-digest percentile module with synthetic latency distributions
Integration: end-to-end routing decision using simulated telemetry (chaos injected p95 spikes)
Load: ensure decision engine QPS scales to 10k reqs/sec with <3ms decision latency
Regression: model-output drift verification for each candidate fallback variant
